entities.summary: Universidad ORT Uruguay (ORT) is a private research university in Montevideo, Uruguay. Established in 1942 as a technical school and officially recognized as a university in 1996, it is part of the global Jewish educational network World ORT. It enrolls more than 10,000 students across five faculties and two institutes, making it one of the largest private higher education institutions in the country.
